scenes.title: The Wobbly Cake
scenes.card: A wedding cake has forty-five minutes to cross a village, and one disaster later, the wobbliest cake in history becomes the best part of the wedding.

scenes.title: Cake day
scenes.card: Bettina and Dash realise the wedding cake is late. The wedding is at four.

subtitles.text: Dash: Miss Bettina! The clock says three!
Bettina: Three?! The wedding is at four!
Dash: And the chapel is on the far hill!
Bettina: Then we run. Take the left, I take the right.
Bettina: Mind the icing! Mind the icing!

scenes.title: Through the market
scenes.card: The best man grabs the cake and strides off with it. 40 minutes left.

subtitles.text: Bettina: Out of the way, please! Wedding cake coming through!
Rufus: Is that the cake? Give it here, I am the best man!
Bettina: You are the best man at what, exactly? Carrying?
Rufus: At everything! Hand it over!
Dash: He’s very big, Miss Bettina.
Rufus: Easy! Nothing could be easier!

scenes.title: The wobble
scenes.card: Rufus wobbles and the cake drops. The top tier is ruined. 25 minutes left.

subtitles.text: Rufus: See? Steady as a rock. Not a wobble. Not one single wobble.
Rufus: Wobble.
Bettina: Don’t you dare...
Dash: The top tier...

scenes.title: All is lost
scenes.card: Bettina sits on a bench, sure the wedding is ruined. 15 minutes left.

subtitles.text: Bettina: Twenty years of baking, and the best cake of my life is a pancake.
Rufus: It was a very good pancake.
Dash: Rufus!

scenes.title: Late, late, late
scenes.card: The bride and groom arrive, also late, and meet the despairing baker. 10 minutes left.

subtitles.text: Juno: Marcel, hurry! We are late for our own wedding!
Marcel: I know. I know. My legs are very long and very slow.
Granny Elm: In my day we ran to weddings.
Juno: Bettina? Is that... the cake?
Bettina: It was. I am so sorry. It is ruined.

scenes.title: The wobbliest cake
scenes.card: The bride decides the wobbly cake is part of the wedding. 5 minutes left.

subtitles.text: Juno: Do you know what I want at my wedding? Friends. And something wobbly to laugh about.
Marcel: Wobbly is our whole family.
Granny Elm: And the cake is the best part.
Juno: Everybody! To the chapel! With the wobbliest cake in history!

scenes.title: Just in time
scenes.card: The wedding starts at four on the dot, wobbly cake and all.

subtitles.text: Marcel: Do you, Juno, take this cake, and also me?
Juno: I do! Both! In that order!

scenes.title: The best slice
scenes.card: Everyone celebrates with the wobbly cake.

subtitles.text: Bettina: Next time I bake a cake, I am not letting anyone near it.
Juno: Next time, bake two. One for eating, one for wobbling.
Dash: I will eat the wobbling one!
Rufus: Best man. Worst carrier. Great cake.
